decision.reason: [ev-1cabcddbde95] says only that a new v1alpha1 Operation controller was implemented. It does not name the API group, so the "crossplane.io" group in the proposed gvk-in-use condition is unsupported. The CRD and render validators could not find the kind in any snapshot either. The excerpt also says nothing about what an environment using the kind would experience, so no exposure condition can be confirmed. To decide, I would need the Operation CRD (its group and version) from the 2.0.0 artifacts, or the PR or upgrade notes describing any effect on existing setups.
